main_text.l: libatus, defertionem parentum, & humanæ socie-tatis, falsos cultus, multas impias traditiones, &c.
II. Infirma. Rechabitarum conscientiæ non obligantur, retinentes libertatem secus faciendi, propter causas necessarias vel probabiles.
Probetur ex textu: quia mutant institutum patris sine peccato migrantes ex agro in urbem bel-li tempore.
III. Infine. Rechabitarum abstinentia non est cultus Dei, ut regulæ monachorum & traditiones esse finguntur.
Probetur [illegible, ~9 letters] finium: Instituta fuisse merè politica vel ethica.
III. Præparatio ad ferendas olim ærumnas publicas.
Amplificetur [illegible, ~10 letters] ab opinione meritorum & perfectionis monasticæ: & opinionis hujus improbatione, ex dicto: Frustra me colunt. &c.
Addatur thesis: Omnes ἐθελοθρησκείας[?] damna-ri à Deo.
Obiectio. Abstinentiam Rechabitarum etiam fuisse cultum: quia à Deo laudatur.
Resp. Laudari reverentiam mandati paterni non illiciti: & fuisse cultum generalem: Honora patrem, &c. cujusmodi cultus Regulæ monasticæ & Traditiones non sunt.

page.notes: The first thesis numeral is read as II (possibly I); the third as III. The Greek words after "Probetur" and "Amplificetur" are not legible with certainty and are marked illegible. The Greek in "Omnes" is a probable reading, marked [?]. The running head is read as THEOLOG.; the scan is slightly blurred there. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
